description.summary: the compositor's magnifier, colour filters and keyboard aids

protocol.description:
The magnifier, the colour inversion and filters, and the keyboard aids (sticky, slow and bounce keys) of the compositor, switched and configured by the shell, and their state. The compositor offers the manager only to the clients its allow-list names for it; it is Athanor's own protocol (doc_own_stack.md OS4 and OS5, doc_accessibility.md AX10 and AX11). Its requests and events follow cosmic_a11y_manager_v1 version 3 where that protocol covers the same thing.
The compositor stores the inversion and the filter, and reads the magnifier's behaviour, where cosmic-comp does, so that both sessions show the same state (doc_accessibility.md AX10). It stores no keyboard aid setting: a client sends them after it binds and at each change, and until one does every aid is off. What a client sets outlives it: destroying the manager or the client's exit changes no state, so the bounds of each request, not the client, keep the keyboard usable.
While the session is locked the aids keep working, on the lock surface too, since their user types the password with them. The keys the compositor always keeps, the protected keys of doc_own_stack.md decision 30 (the reveal key, Super+Escape, Super+Alt+Escape, Ctrl+Alt+Tab, Super+Alt+A, Super+Alt+S and the switch to a text console), pass slow keys and bounce keys unfiltered, so that no setting of the aids makes the lock surface unusable. While the session is locked, and while a surface the compositor identifies by its client's line in the allow-list as a trusted prompt has the keyboard focus, the modifiers, key_rejected and gesture events are not sent, so that nothing of a password's typing reaches a client; the modifiers event is sent again when that ends. The allow-list has no mark of a trusted prompt yet: the first code that serves the keyboard aids adds it (doc_own_stack.md OS5, proposed with revision 3 of doc_accessibility.md, #865).
A new version adds interfaces, requests, events or enum entries; a client binds the version it knows.

interface.name: athanor_a11y_manager_v1

description.summary: the accessibility features of the compositor

interface.description:
Switches the magnifier and the colour filters, configures the keyboard aids, and sends their state. When the manager is bound, the magnifier, screen_filter and modifiers events are sent at once, then each at each change; the modifiers event is sent at once unless the session is locked or a trusted prompt has the focus, in which case at the end of it.
A zoom step multiplies or divides the level by one plus the increment of cosmic-comp's accessibility_zoom as a fraction (50 is 1.5 times), as cosmic-comp does, and keeps it between 1 and cosmic-comp's maximum, 256; a level below 1.01 is 1, the magnifier off. An increment of 0, which would never change the level, or one that cannot be read, is replaced by cosmic-comp's default, 50, and logged.

entry.name: invalid_value
entry.summary: an argument is not a value of its enum, or lies outside its bounds

enum.name: filter
enum.description: The values are those of cosmic_a11y_manager_v1's filter enum. As in its version 2, none (cosmic's disabled) turns the filter off, where its version 3 adds a separate filter_state: the stored state is cosmic-comp's record, which holds one filter or none, not a chosen filter switched off.

entry.name: unknown
entry.summary: a filter this version does not name; in a request, the current filter kept

request.name: destroy
request.description: The magnifier, the filters and the keyboard aids keep their state and settings, in this session, until a client changes them.

request.name: set_magnifier

description.summary: turn the magnifier on or off

request.description: Turns the magnifier on at the last level it had in this session, or at one zoom step, or off. The client waits for the magnifier event before it shows the change.

request.name: zoom_in
request.description: Raises the level by one zoom step, as the zoom-in key does. With the magnifier off, turns it on at one step.

request.name: zoom_out
request.description: Lowers the level by one zoom step, as the zoom-out key does; at level 1 the magnifier is off. With the magnifier off, does nothing.

request.name: set_screen_filter

description.summary: set the colour inversion and filter

request.description: Sets the inversion and the filter, and stores them as cosmic-comp does. A filter of unknown keeps the current filter, so that a client can change the inversion without knowing the filter. The client waits for the screen_filter event before it shows the change.

event.name: screen_filter

description.summary: the state of the colour inversion and filter

event.description: A filter in the stored state that this version does not name is sent as unknown. This is what is drawn: a compositor that cannot draw the pass sends disabled and none, whatever is stored.

request.name: set_sticky_keys
request.description: With sticky keys on, a modifier pressed and released alone is latched for the next key, and pressed twice is locked until it is pressed again. With two_key_off enabled, two keys pressed together turn sticky keys off, and the compositor sends aid_off. Turning sticky keys off releases every latched and locked modifier.

request.name: set_slow_keys
request.description: With slow keys on, a key other than the protected keys is accepted only once it has been held for delay milliseconds; a key released earlier is rejected. A delay above 2000 raises invalid_value.

arg.name: delay
arg.summary: the time a key is held before it is accepted, in ms, from 0 to 2000

request.name: set_bounce_keys
request.description: With bounce keys on, a press of a key other than the protected keys within delay milliseconds of its last release is rejected. A delay above 2000 raises invalid_value.

arg.name: delay
arg.summary: the time after a release in which the key is ignored, in ms, from 0 to 2000

request.name: set_aid_gestures
request.description: With the gestures enabled, Shift pressed five times in a row is reported as the sticky_keys gesture, and Shift held for eight seconds as the slow_keys gesture. The compositor changes no setting for a gesture: the client offers the aid to the user. Disabled until the client enables them.

event.name: modifiers
event.description: The modifiers sticky keys holds latched and locked; a modifier absent is neither. Not sent while the session is locked or a trusted prompt has the keyboard focus.

event.name: key_rejected
event.description: Slow keys or bounce keys rejected a key press. Which key is never sent. Not sent while the session is locked or a trusted prompt has the keyboard focus.

event.name: gesture
event.description: The gesture that offers sticky keys or slow keys, sent only while the gestures are enabled, and not while the session is locked or a trusted prompt has the keyboard focus. bounce_keys is never sent.

event.name: aid_off

description.summary: the compositor turned an aid off

event.description: The compositor turned an aid off itself: sticky_keys, by two-key-off. The client stores the aid as off, so that the setting it sends next agrees. Sent when it happens, or when the lock or the trusted prompt's focus ends if it happened then.
